d.d: An instrument for mowing grass, grain, etc. by hand, composed of a long, curving blade with a sharp concave edge, fastened to a long handle called a snath.
A scythe-shaped blade attached to ancient war chariots.
To cut off as with a scythe; to mow.
third-person singular simple present indicative of scythe
Of or relating to Scythia (a region of Central Eurasia in the classical era) or its inhabitants.
